annotations.title: Remove chats from the sync list

description: Takes supergroups and channels off the sync list, so the mirror stops keeping their messages and deletes the ones it holds, with their earlier versions. Changes only the local mirror and the sync list; nothing changes at Telegram. Needs the sync service running. The list holds at most 30 chats. The whole call is refused when any chat cannot be listed: private chats, bots, basic groups and Saved Messages are always kept, and channels can be listed only with the channels setting on. Chats come as ids from `telegram_chat_read` method `list`, never names. A chat that is not on the list is reported under `absent`, so repeating a call is harmless. If the call ends `uncertain`, check `telegram_sync_read` before trying again.

account.description: The account label; may be left out when only one account is logged in.

chats.description: The chats to change, by id from `telegram_chat_read` method `list`, such as -1001234567890: 1 to 30 distinct ids. A name, username or phone number is not a chat.

name: telegram_sync_remove

absent.description: The chats that were not on the sync list; nothing changed for them.

limit.description: The most chats the sync list holds: 30.

note.description: What happens to the removed chats and how to read them.

removed.description: The chats taken off the sync list; their mirrored messages and earlier versions are gone.
